title: Critical-minerals export-restriction shocks and ETF realized-volatility transmission

events.source_note: MOFCOM press conference confirms gallium and germanium export controls announced before July 6 and effective Aug 1 2023.
IEA policy tracker records MOFCOM/GAC Oct 20 2023 graphite export-permit announcement effective Dec 1 2023.
MOFCOM press conference confirms Aug 15 2024 antimony and superhard-material export controls effective Sep 15 2024.
MOFCOM Announcement No.46 of 2024 tightens related dual-use exports to the United States.
MOFCOM press conference confirms Feb 4 2025 export controls on tungsten tellurium bismuth molybdenum and indium related items.
IEA policy tracker records ARECOMS Decision No.001/ARECOMS/2025 suspending DRC cobalt exports from Feb 22 2025.
MOFCOM/GAC Announcement No.18 of 2025 imposes controls on some medium and heavy rare-earth related items from Apr 4 2025.
MOFCOM spokesperson remarks state that China released export control measures on rare earths and related items on Oct 9 2025.

LIT.description: lithium and battery value chain ETF

bootstrap.method: random-anchor one-sided right-tail p-value on each ticker full sample

method.lookahead_protection: T=0 maps to first trading day >= announcement date. All post-event metrics start at T+1. Pre baseline ends at T-6, leaving T-5..T as a discarded gap.

literature_and_context.source: OECD Inventory of Export Restrictions on Critical Raw Materials 2026
literature_and_context.use: Motivates export restrictions as a growing CRM supply-chain risk.
Motivates critical minerals as energy, technology, and broader-economy supply-chain risks.
Cross-checks graphite and DRC cobalt policy-event dates.

aggregate_all_metrics_descriptive.note: descriptive only; mixes RV mean-ratio metrics and jump max/mean ratio

jump_bootstrap_summary.note: jump5_abs uses random-anchor bootstrap only; ratio>1 sign tests are not interpretable because a five-day max is expected to exceed a one-period mean.

market_confound_notes: 2025-04-04 rare-earth event is confounded by the same week's broad tariff-driven market volatility. In this event, SPY/QQQ rv5 and jump5_abs ratios are also high, and direct mineral mean rv5/jump ratios do not exceed benchmark mean ratios.
